# toml++ 3.4.0

The private parser header is the upstream [3.4.0 single-header release](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marzer/tomlplusplus/v3.4.0/toml.hpp), commit `30172438cee64926dc41fdd9c11fb3ba5b2ba9de`. Its unmodified SHA-256 is `6b5172ad4dd6519aec67b919181fa7a38a2234131e5b2afa232dfe444819783e`; the patched header SHA-256 is `277dd6d4d40f75aee6747af2fa7552b5f80553d11754c88c739ffc716c0c1b21`. MIT license: [notice](../../docs/licenses/tomlplusplus.txt).

The local patch removes `noexcept` from array/table default and move constructors and move assignments, from the parser result conversion, and from the throwing-mode parse-error constructors (which allocate their message). MSVC Debug STL container initialization or move can allocate iterator proxies; an allocation failure must propagate to the parser staging boundary instead of terminating. The patch also disables the optional macro-selected configuration header and makes the two header-availability probes explicit, so the native-input attestation can enumerate the entire include closure. The parser additionally admits at most 128 segments per dotted key and 1,024 key segments per document; these limits bound recursive graph destruction and report capacity rather than invalid TOML. Three literal operator declarations use the non-deprecated C++ spelling to avoid MSVC C5311. No other grammar or data model logic is changed. The full observed allocation sweep and all native profiles remain required before qualification.
